metric_explanation: test_coverage_percent: Line coverage for the target source module.; defect_detection_rate_percent: Failing/error tests divided by total executed tests. Higher means defects are found with fewer tests.; execution_time_seconds: Measured pytest execution time for the benchmarked test set. For agentic mode this is the selected/generated target tests, not the full LLM pipeline setup time.; number_of_tests_executed: Total pytest outcomes counted from the final pytest summary: passed + failed + errors + skipped + xfailed + xpassed.; test_reduction_percentage: How many fewer tests were executed compared with the traditional target-test baseline.; pass_rate_percent: Passed tests divided by total executed tests.; generated_test_validity_rate_percent: Agentic only: generated tests that executed without collection/runtime infrastructure errors. Failing assertions still count as valid defect-detection tests.; coverage_improvement_percent: Coverage difference compared with the traditional target-test baseline.; selection_accuracy_percent: Selected test files that directly target the source module divided by all selected test files.; manual_effort_proxy_minutes: Transparent proxy estimate from executed tests/heal attempts. Use only as an automation-effort indicator, not measured human time.; efficiency_score_percent: Weighted index from defect density, test reduction, execution saving, coverage, pass rate, and selection accuracy.
